versos.grego: Ἀδελφοί μου, μὴ ἐν προσωπολημψίαις ἔχετε τὴν πίστιν τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τῆς δόξης.

controles.web: My brothers, don’t hold the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ of glory with partiality.
controles.kjv: My brethren, have not the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Lord of glory, with respect of persons.
controles.livre: Meus irmãos, não tenhais a fé do nosso glorioso Senhor Jesus Cristo em acepção de pessoas.

versos.grego: ἐὰν γὰρ εἰσέλθῃ εἰς συναγωγὴν ὑμῶν ἀνὴρ χρυσοδακτύλιος ἐν ἐσθῆτι λαμπρᾷ, εἰσέλθῃ δὲ καὶ πτωχὸς ἐν ῥυπαρᾷ ἐσθῆτι,

controles.web: For if a man with a gold ring, in fine clothing, comes into your synagogue, and a poor man in filthy clothing also comes in;
controles.kjv: For if there come unto your assembly a man with a gold ring, in goodly apparel, and there come in also a poor man in vile raiment;
controles.livre: Pois se algum homem entrar na vossa congregação com anéis de ouro e trajes preciosos, e também entrar algum pobre com roupa de pouco valor,

versos.grego: ἐπιβλέψητε δὲ ἐπὶ τὸν φοροῦντα τὴν ἐσθῆτα τὴν λαμπρὰν καὶ εἴπητε Σὺ κάθου ὧδε καλῶς, καὶ τῷ πτωχῷ εἴπητε Σὺ στῆθι ἐκεῖ ἢ κάθου ὑπὸ τὸ ὑποπόδιόν μου,

controles.web: and you pay special attention to him who wears the fine clothing, and say, “Sit here in a good place”; and you tell the poor man, “Stand there,” or “Sit by my footstool”;
controles.kjv: And ye have respect to him that weareth the gay clothing, and say unto him, Sit thou here in a good place; and say to the poor, Stand thou there, or sit here under my footstool:
controles.livre: e derdes atenção ao que usa o traje precioso, e disserdes: “Senta aqui, num lugar de honra”, mas ao pobre disserdes: “Fica ali em pé” ou “senta-te abaixo do apoio dos meus pés”,

versos.grego: οὐ διεκρίθητε ἐν ἑαυτοῖς καὶ ἐγένεσθε κριταὶ διαλογισμῶν πονηρῶν;

controles.web: haven’t you shown partiality among yourselves, and become judges with evil thoughts?
controles.kjv: Are ye not then partial in yourselves, and are become judges of evil thoughts?
controles.livre: por acaso não fizestes discriminação entre vós mesmos, e não vos tornastes juízes de maus pensamentos?

versos.grego: Ἀκούσατε, ἀδελφοί μου ἀγαπητοί. οὐχ ὁ Θεὸς ἐξελέξατο τοὺς πτωχοὺς τῷ κόσμῳ πλουσίους ἐν πίστει καὶ κληρονόμους τῆς βασιλείας ἧς ἐπηγγείλατο τοῖς ἀγαπῶσιν αὐτόν;

controles.web: Listen, my beloved brothers. Didn’t God choose those who are poor in this world to be rich in faith, and heirs of the Kingdom which he promised to those who love him?
controles.kjv: Hearken, my beloved brethren, Hath not God chosen the poor of this world rich in faith, and heirs of the kingdom which he hath promised to them that love him?
controles.livre: Ouvi, meus amados irmãos: acaso Deus não escolheu os pobres quanto ao mundo para serem ricos na fé, e herdeiros do reino que ele prometeu aos que o amam?

versos.grego: ὑμεῖς δὲ ἠτιμάσατε τὸν πτωχόν. οὐχ οἱ πλούσιοι καταδυναστεύουσιν ὑμῶν, καὶ αὐτοὶ ἕλκουσιν ὑμᾶς εἰς κριτήρια;

controles.web: But you have dishonored the poor man. Don’t the rich oppress you, and personally drag you before the courts?
controles.kjv: But ye have despised the poor. Do not rich men oppress you, and draw you before the judgment seats?
controles.livre: Vós, porém, desonrastes o pobre. Acaso não são os ricos que vos oprimem e vos arrastam para os tribunais?

versos.grego: οὐκ αὐτοὶ βλασφημοῦσιν τὸ καλὸν ὄνομα τὸ ἐπικληθὲν ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς;

controles.web: Don’t they blaspheme the honorable name by which you are called?
controles.kjv: Do not they blaspheme that worthy name by the which ye are called?
controles.livre: Não são eles que blasfemam o bom nome pelo qual sois chamados?

versos.grego: εἰ μέντοι νόμον τελεῖτε βασιλικὸν κατὰ τὴν γραφήν Ἀγαπήσεις τὸν πλησίον σου ὡς σεαυτόν, καλῶς ποιεῖτε·

controles.web: However, if you fulfill the royal law, according to the Scripture, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself,” you do well.
controles.kjv: If ye fulfil the royal law according to the scripture, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself, ye do well:
controles.livre: Se de fato cumpris a lei real conforme a Escritura: Amarás o teu próximo como a ti mesmo, bem fazeis;

versos.grego: εἰ δὲ προσωπολημπτεῖτε, ἁμαρτίαν ἐργάζεσθε, ἐλεγχόμενοι ὑπὸ τοῦ νόμου ὡς παραβάται.

controles.web: But if you show partiality, you commit sin, being convicted by the law as transgressors.
controles.kjv: But if ye have respect to persons, ye commit sin, and are convinced of the law as transgressors.
controles.livre: Mas se fazeis acepção de pessoas, cometeis pecado, e sois denunciados pela lei como transgressores.

versos.grego: ὅστις γὰρ ὅλον τὸν νόμον τηρήσῃ, πταίσῃ δὲ ἐν ἑνί, γέγονεν πάντων ἔνοχος.

controles.web: For whoever keeps the whole law, and yet stumbles in one point, he has become guilty of all.
controles.kjv: For whosoever shall keep the whole law, and yet offend in one point, he is guilty of all.
controles.livre: Pois quem guarda toda a lei, mas falha em um item , tornou-se culpado de todos.

versos.grego: ὁ γὰρ εἰπών Μὴ μοιχεύσῃς, εἶπεν καί Μὴ φονεύσῃς· εἰ δὲ οὐ μοιχεύεις, φονεύεις δέ, γέγονας παραβάτης νόμου.

controles.web: For he who said, “Do not commit adultery,” also said, “Do not commit murder.” Now if you do not commit adultery, but murder, you have become a transgressor of the law.
controles.kjv: For he that said, Do not commit adultery, said also, Do not kill. Now if thou commit no adultery, yet if thou kill, thou art become a transgressor of the law.
controles.livre: Porque aquele que disse: “Não cometerás adultério”,  também disse: “Não matarás”.  Portanto, se não cometeres adultério, mas matares, te tornaste um transgressor da lei.

versos.grego: οὕτως λαλεῖτε καὶ οὕτως ποιεῖτε ὡς διὰ νόμου ἐλευθερίας μέλλοντες κρίνεσθαι.

controles.web: So speak, and so do, as men who are to be judged by a law of freedom.
controles.kjv: So speak ye, and so do, as they that shall be judged by the law of liberty.
controles.livre: Falai assim e procedei assim: como os que serão julgados pela lei da liberdade;

versos.grego: ἡ γὰρ κρίσις ἀνέλεος τῷ μὴ ποιήσαντι ἔλεος· κατακαυχᾶται ἔλεος κρίσεως.

controles.web: For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.
controles.kjv: For he shall have judgment without mercy, that hath shewed no mercy; and mercy rejoiceth against judgment.
controles.livre: porque o julgamento será sem misericórdia sobre quem não agiu com misericórdia; mas a misericórdia triunfa sobre o julgamento.

versos.grego: Τί τὸ ὄφελος, ἀδελφοί μου, ἐὰν πίστιν λέγῃ τις ἔχειν ἔργα δὲ μὴ ἔχῃ; μὴ δύναται ἡ πίστις σῶσαι αὐτόν;

controles.web: What good is it, my brothers, if a man says he has faith, but has no works? Can faith save him?
controles.kjv: What doth it profit, my brethren, though a man say he hath faith, and have not works? can faith save him?
controles.livre: Meus irmãos, qual é o proveito se alguém disser que tem fé, mas não tiver obras? Acaso a fé pode salvá-lo?

versos.grego: ἐὰν ἀδελφὸς ἢ ἀδελφὴ γυμνοὶ ὑπάρχωσιν καὶ λειπόμενοι τῆς ἐφημέρου τροφῆς,

controles.web: And if a brother or sister is naked and in lack of daily food,
controles.kjv: If a brother or sister be naked, and destitute of daily food,
controles.livre: E se um irmão ou irmã estiverem nus, e necessitarem do alimento diário,

versos.grego: εἴπῃ δέ τις αὐτοῖς ἐξ ὑμῶν Ὑπάγετε ἐν εἰρήνῃ, θερμαίνεσθε καὶ χορτάζεσθε, μὴ δῶτε δὲ αὐτοῖς τὰ ἐπιτήδεια τοῦ σώματος, τί τὸ ὄφελος;

controles.web: and one of you tells them, “Go in peace, be warmed and filled”; and yet you didn’t give them the things the body needs, what good is it?
controles.kjv: And one of you say unto them, Depart in peace, be ye warmed and filled; notwithstanding ye give them not those things which are needful to the body; what doth it profit?
controles.livre: e algum de vós lhes disser: “Ide em paz, aquecei-vos e saciai-vos”; e não lhes derdes as coisas necessárias ao corpo, qual é o proveito disso ?

versos.grego: οὕτως καὶ ἡ πίστις, ἐὰν μὴ ἔχῃ ἔργα, νεκρά ἐστιν καθ’ ἑαυτήν.

controles.web: Even so faith, if it has no works, is dead in itself.
controles.kjv: Even so faith, if it hath not works, is dead, being alone.
controles.livre: Assim também a fé, se não tiver obras, é morta em si mesma.

versos.grego: ἀλλ’ ἐρεῖ τις Σὺ πίστιν ἔχεις, κἀγὼ ἔργα ἔχω· δεῖξόν μοι τὴν πίστιν σου χωρὶς τῶν ἔργων, κἀγώ σοι δείξω ἐκ τῶν ἔργων μου τὴν πίστιν.

controles.web: Yes, a man will say, “You have faith, and I have works.” Show me your faith without works, and I by my works will show you my faith.
controles.kjv: Yea, a man may say, Thou hast faith, and I have works: shew me thy faith without thy works, and I will shew thee my faith by my works.
controles.livre: Mas alguém dirá: Tu tens fé e eu tenho obras. Mostra-me a tua fé sem as tuas obras, e eu, pelas minhas obras, te mostrarei a minha fé.

versos.grego: σὺ πιστεύεις ὅτι εἷς ἐστιν ὁ Θεός; καλῶς ποιεῖς· καὶ τὰ δαιμόνια πιστεύουσιν καὶ φρίσσουσιν.

controles.web: You believe that God is one. You do well. The demons also believe, and shudder.
controles.kjv: Thou believest that there is one God; thou doest well: the devils also believe, and tremble.
controles.livre: Tu crês que há um só Deus? Fazes bem; os demônios também creem, e estremecem.

versos.grego: θέλεις δὲ γνῶναι, ὦ ἄνθρωπε κενέ, ὅτι ἡ πίστις χωρὶς τῶν ἔργων ἀργή ἐστιν;

controles.web: But do you want to know, vain man, that faith apart from works is dead?
controles.kjv: But wilt thou know, O vain man, that faith without works is dead?
controles.livre: Ó tolo, queres te certificar de que a fé sem as obras é inútil?

versos.grego: Ἀβραὰμ ὁ πατὴρ ἡμῶν οὐκ ἐξ ἔργων ἐδικαιώθη, ἀνενέγκας Ἰσαὰκ τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον;

controles.web: Wasn’t Abraham our father justified by works, in that he offered up Isaac his son on the altar?
controles.kjv: Was not Abraham our father justified by works, when he had offered Isaac his son upon the altar?
controles.livre: Acaso não foi o nosso pai Abraão justificado pelas obras, quando ofereceu o seu filho Isaque sobre o altar?

versos.grego: βλέπεις ὅτι ἡ πίστις συνήργει τοῖς ἔργοις αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἔργων ἡ πίστις ἐτελειώθη,

controles.web: You see that faith worked with his works, and by works faith was perfected;
controles.kjv: Seest thou how faith wrought with his works, and by works was faith made perfect?
controles.livre: Vês que a fé cooperou com as suas obras, e que pelas obras a fé foi aperfeiçoada.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐπληρώθη ἡ γραφὴ ἡ λέγουσα Ἐπίστευσεν δὲ Ἀβραὰμ τῷ Θεῷ, καὶ ἐλογίσθη αὐτῷ εἰς δικαιοσύνην, καὶ φίλος Θεοῦ ἐκλήθη.

controles.web: and the Scripture was fulfilled which says, “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him as righteousness”; and he was called the friend of God.
controles.kjv: And the scripture was fulfilled which saith, Abraham believed God, and it was imputed unto him for righteousness: and he was called the Friend of God.
controles.livre: E cumpriu-se a Escritura que diz: “E Abraão creu em Deus, e isso lhe foi considerado como justiça”,  e ele foi chamado amigo de Deus.

versos.grego: ὁρᾶτε ὅτι ἐξ ἔργων δικαιοῦται ἄνθρωπος καὶ οὐκ ἐκ πίστεως μόνον.

controles.web: You see then that by works, a man is justified, and not only by faith.
controles.kjv: Ye see then how that by works a man is justified, and not by faith only.
controles.livre: Vedes que o ser humano é justificado pelas obras, e não somente pela fé.

versos.grego: ὁμοίως δὲ καὶ Ῥαὰβ ἡ πόρνη οὐκ ἐξ ἔργων ἐδικαιώθη, ὑποδεξαμένη τοὺς ἀγγέλους καὶ ἑτέρᾳ ὁδῷ ἐκβαλοῦσα;

controles.web: In the same way, wasn’t Rahab the prostitute also justified by works, in that she received the messengers, and sent them out another way?
controles.kjv: Likewise also was not Rahab the harlot justified by works, when she had received the messengers, and had sent them out another way?
controles.livre: E de igual modo não foi também a prostituta Raabe justificada pelas obras, quando recebeu os mensageiros, e ajudou para que saíssem por outro caminho?

versos.grego: ὥσπερ γὰρ τὸ σῶμα χωρὶς πνεύματος νεκρόν ἐστιν, οὕτως καὶ ἡ πίστις χωρὶς ἔργων νεκρά ἐστιν.

controles.web: For as the body apart from the spirit is dead, even so faith apart from works is dead.
controles.kjv: For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also.
controles.livre: Pois assim como o corpo sem o espírito está morto, assim também a fé sem obras está morta.
